column20:
*Optimism* / *pessimism* (noun: uncountable) | Questions: 18*Are you the kind of person who likes to wake up early in the morning?*
8*Not really, no*. 8*It's not* that I like to wake up late. 8*I just* like to wake up at a natural time when I feel that 8*I've rested enough*. I've never really been *the type of person who* feels that I have to wake up 8*at the crack of dawn* in order to 8*make the most of the day*. So, 8*I'll usually* sleep for around 7 or 8 hours and get up at around 7 or 8 in the morning. Perhaps, at the weekend I'll 8*sleep in* slightly longer.*
